translationRepairs: During the Zhiping era he entered service as direct lecturer at the Imperial University, was promoted to assistant compiler in the Secretariat, and successively served as collator in the palace libraries, collator in the Hall of Assembled Talents, examiner in the History Office, and director of rites at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

During the Zhiping era he entered service as direct lecturer at the Imperial University, was promoted to assistant editorial director of the Palace Library, and successively served as collator in the palace libraries, collator in the Hall of Assembled Talents, examiner in the History Office, and director of rites at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

The Yellow River had been flowing north for nearly forty years; hydraulic officials proposed returning it to the old channel; Cun contended: "The old channel is already elevated while the water tends downward—only to waste resources with little hope of success."

The Yellow River had been flowing north for nearly ten years; hydraulic officials proposed returning it to the old channel; Cun contended: "The old channel is already elevated while the water tends downward—only to waste resources with little hope of success."
幾十年 means nearly ten years.
After more than a year he was given additional rank as academician of the Privy Council and made prefect of Yangzhou.
After more than a year he was given additional rank as academician of the Zizheng Hall and made prefect of Yangzhou.
Cuzai Shi Jie, upon a single meeting, looked to him as a future chief counselor.
Shi Jie of Culai, upon a single meeting, looked to him as a future chief counselor.
徂徠 is Culai, his sobriquet.
He was transferred to magistrate of Huoyi, promoted to Secretariat director, and made detailed reviewer in the Court for Scrutiny of Offenses.
He was transferred to magistrate of Huoyi, promoted to assistant in the Palace Library, and made detailed reviewer in the Court for Scrutiny of Offenses.
I beg that the military discussions of Han Anguo of Han, Wei Xiang of Wei, and Wei Zheng of Tang be collated for comparison, and right and wrong will stand clear.
I beg that the military discussions of Han Anguo and Wei Xiang of Han and Wei Zheng of Tang be collated for comparison, and right and wrong will stand clear.
魏相 was a Han chancellor.
Called back to head the Court for Scrutiny, again overseeing Silver Terrace and seal review, lecturer-in-waiting, and administrator of the Court of Imperial Works.
Called back to head the Court for Scrutiny, again overseeing Silver Terrace and seal review, reader-in-waiting, and administrator of the Court of Imperial Works.
At the time deliberation honored Emperor Xianzu as founding ancestor; Gu argued: "Gaozu of Han differed from Shang and Zhou in gaining the empire, so the Great Supreme could not be founding fief;
At the time deliberation honored Emperor Xizu as founding ancestor; Gu argued: "Gaozu of Han differed from Shang and Zhou in gaining the empire, so the Great Supreme could not be founding fief;
僖祖 is Xizu, not Xianzu.
Late in the Xining era he was made Secretariat Direct Academician and prefect of Kaifeng.
Late in the Xining era he was made Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and prefect of Kaifeng.

He was promoted to Grandee of Palace Attendance and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, then advanced to Director of the bureau. Illness forced him to step aside, and he was made Wenyuan Hall Academician and prefect of Heyang, then soon superintendent of Chongfu Palace on Mount Song.

He was promoted to Grandee of Palace Attendance and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, then advanced to Director of the bureau. Illness forced him to step aside, and he was made Guanwen Hall Academician and prefect of Heyang, then soon superintendent of Chongfu Palace on Mount Song.
Court audiences were suspended for two days. He was posthumously made Grand Preceptor with ceremonial honors equal to the Three Excellencies, and given the posthumous title Wenjing.
Court audiences were suspended for two days. He was posthumously made Commander Unequalled in Honor, and given the posthumous title Wenjing.
開府儀同三司 is not Grand Preceptor.

As Secretariat Assistant he also governed Yongchang County, where he built six irrigation weirs. Annual tax levies fell by hundreds of thousands, water disputes died away, and the people compared him to the famous administrators Zhao and Du.

As Assistant in the Palace Library he also governed Yongchang County, where he built six irrigation weirs. Annual tax levies fell by hundreds of thousands, water disputes died away, and the people compared him to the famous administrators Shao Xinchen and Du Shi.
秘書丞 rendering. 召、杜 are Shao Xinchen and Du Shi.
He was promoted to Assistant in the Ministry of Revenue's Fields Section.
He was promoted to Vice Director of the State Farms Bureau.

When the Xia raided Wangguan, the Qingzhou commander Sun Changqing failed to repel them, yet he was promoted to Academician of the Hall for Advancing Worthies. Zhao protested that he should have been dismissed, not rewarded, calling it a reversal of reward and punishment.

When the Xia raided Wangguan, the Qingzhou commander Sun Changqing failed to repel them, yet he was promoted to Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies. Zhao protested that he should have been dismissed, not rewarded, calling it a reversal of reward and punishment.

Before long the Grand Empress Dowager wrote by hand to honor the prince as emperor. Zhao sighed and said, "Earlier the empress dowager had sternly rebuked the chief ministers, and the debate was halted.
Before long the Empress Dowager wrote by hand to honor the prince as emperor. Zhao sighed and said, "Earlier the empress dowager had sternly rebuked the chief ministers, and the debate was halted.
皇太后 is empress dowager, not grand.

When Emperor Shenzong ascended the throne, Zhao was promoted to Assistant in the Ministry of Rites' Enfeoffment Section and made prefect of Shang Prefecture, then appointed Intendant of Shaanxi Judicial Affairs.
When Emperor Shenzong ascended the throne, Zhao was promoted to Vice Director of the Bureau of Honors and made prefect of Shang Prefecture, then appointed Intendant of Shaanxi Judicial Affairs.
When Emperor Zhezong ascended the throne, Zhao was promoted to Grandee of Court Discussion, summoned as Vice Minister of Rites, and promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue.
When Emperor Zhezong ascended the throne, Zhao was promoted to Grandee of Court Discussion, summoned as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue.
In the third year of Yuanyou (1088) he was promoted to Academician Ex Officio of the Privy Council with concurrent duty as Privy Council signatory.
In the third year of Yuanyou (1088) he was promoted to Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
樞密直學士 and 簽書樞密院事.
Great Wu was therefore opened to protect the Northern Capital (Kaifeng).
Great Wu was therefore opened to protect the Northern Capital (Daming).
北都 was Daming, not Kaifeng.
Zhao also memorialized to abolish Quchuan Army to ease the burden on Jing and Hu circuits;
Zhao also memorialized to abolish Quyang Army to ease the burden on Jing and Hu circuits;
He was posthumously awarded Silver Blue-Glitter Grandee of Glorious Blessing, with the posthumous title Yijian (Blessed and Simple).
He was posthumously awarded Grand Master of Silver Glory, with the posthumous title Yijian (Blessed and Simple).
Fu Yaoyu, whose style name was Qinzhi, was originally from Xucheng in Yan Prefecture and later moved to Jiyuan in Meng Prefecture.
Fu Yaoyu, whose style name was Qinzhi, was originally from Xucheng in Yun Prefecture and later moved to Jiyuan in Meng Prefecture.

When he supervised the Western Capital Tax Office, the prefects Yan Shu and Xia Song both told him, "You have pure insight and elegant bearing. Your writing is concise yet exhaustive in reasoning. You have the talent of a chief minister."

When he supervised the Western Capital Tax Office, the regents Yan Shu and Xia Song both told him, "You have pure insight and elegant bearing. Your writing is concise yet exhaustive in reasoning. You have the talent of a chief minister."
留守 is regent, not prefect.
He served as magistrate of Xinxin County and was repeatedly promoted to Erudite of the Imperial Temple.
He served as magistrate of Xinxi County and was repeatedly promoted to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
新息縣 is Xinxi. 太常博士 rendering.
The Princess of Guo married Li Wei but was estranged from her husband by her household supervisors Liang Huaiji and Zhang Chengzhao, who came between them.
The Princess of Yanguo married Li Wei but was estranged from her husband by her household supervisors Liang Huaiji and Zhang Chengzhao, who came between them.

The eunuchs Li Yun'gong and Zhu Hui bent the law to appoint their sons; Zhao Jibao was put in charge of the Tianzhang Pavilion out of turn; Cai Shining managed the inner treasury and privately showed pearls to palace women.

The eunuchs Li Yun'gong and Zhu Hui bent the law to appoint their sons; Zhao Jichong was put in charge of the Tianzhang Pavilion out of turn; Cai Shining managed the inner treasury and privately showed pearls to palace women.
When Emperor Yingzong took the throne, Yaoyu was transferred to Attendant Censor of the Palace and promoted to Drafting Attendant.
When Emperor Yingzong took the throne, Yaoyu was transferred to Attendant Censor of the Palace and promoted to Imperial Diarist.
He and the investigating censor Lü Hui submitted more than ten joint memorials, pressing their arguments to the utmost.
He and the attendant censor Lü Hui submitted more than ten joint memorials, pressing their arguments to the utmost.

Soon Yaoyu and Zhao Zhan were dispatched as envoys to the Khitan. After they returned, Lü Hui, Lü Daguan, and Fan Chunren were all removed for opposing the Pu affair; Yaoyu was reappointed Attending Censor with concurrent charge of miscellaneous business.

Soon Yaoyu and Zhao Zhan were dispatched as envoys to the Khitan. After they returned, Lü Hui, Lü Dafang, and Fan Chunren were all removed for opposing the Pu affair; Yaoyu was reappointed Attending Censor with concurrent charge of miscellaneous business.

Anshi took offense and merely gave him Direct Attendant of the Zhaowen Pavilion and acting Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Commission; soon he was sent out as Hebei transport commissioner, then reassigned as prefect of Jiangning.

Anshi took offense and merely gave him Direct Attendant of the Zhaowen Pavilion and acting Vice Commissioner of Salt and Iron; soon he was sent out as Hebei transport commissioner, then reassigned as prefect of Jiangning.

When Zhezong acceded, he was summoned from Ming Prefecture as Vice Director of the Secretariat with concurrent Court Lecturer, then promoted through Supervising Censor, Vice Minister of Personnel, and Censor-in-Chief.

When Zhezong acceded, he was summoned from Ming Prefecture as Vice Director of the Palace Library with concurrent Court Lecturer, then promoted through Supervising Secretary, Vice Minister of Personnel, and Censor-in-Chief.
秘書少監 rendering. 給事中 rendering.
He was posthumously granted Silver-Gleam Grandee of Glorious Blessing, with the posthumous title Xianjian (Presenting Simplicity).
He was posthumously granted Grand Master of Silver Glory, with the posthumous title Xianjian (Presenting Simplicity).
